fact_text: Jubilee Life Insurance said it launched its corporate wellness model in 2016 and calls itself the pioneer of the approach in Pakistan, where corporate wellness did not exist then.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From Insurance to Wellness: Inside Jubilee Life Insurance Approach | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-10-08)

fact_text: Jubilee said it appointed a wellness ambassador when it launched its model in 2016, and has since run on-site training and seminars on work-life balance and stress management.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From Insurance to Wellness: Inside Jubilee Life Insurance Approach | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-10-08)

fact_text: Jubilee's wellness model is described by management as covering financial, mental and physical wellbeing, going beyond health insurance and gym memberships, which it said staff often did not use.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From Insurance to Wellness: Inside Jubilee Life Insurance Approach | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-10-08)

fact_text: Jubilee Life Insurance said its insurance panel covers 550 hospitals across Pakistan, where insured staff can be treated on negotiated rates without paying cash.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From Insurance to Wellness: Inside Jubilee Life Insurance Approach | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-10-08)

fact_text: Jubilee Life Insurance said its corporate business team of 80 people is the largest team it has.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From Insurance to Wellness: Inside Jubilee Life Insurance Approach | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-10-08)

fact_text: Jubilee cardholders get a 12% discount on labs, radiology and medicines at Aga Khan University Hospital, according to the company.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From Insurance to Wellness: Inside Jubilee Life Insurance Approach | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-10-08)

fact_text: Jubilee Life Insurance said 90% of its reimbursement claims are paid within one to two days of submission.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From Insurance to Wellness: Inside Jubilee Life Insurance Approach | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-10-08)

fact_text: Jubilee described its reimbursement workflow as scanning, review by one doctor, approval by a second doctor, accounts and an IBFT bank transfer, and called it seamless with no human step needed.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From Insurance to Wellness: Inside Jubilee Life Insurance Approach | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-10-08)

fact_text: Jubilee said it runs a 24/7 call centre and places client service officers at hospitals across Pakistan to help with emergency admissions.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From Insurance to Wellness: Inside Jubilee Life Insurance Approach | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-10-08)

fact_text: Jubilee said its claims data shows most claims relate to heart problems, childbirth and hypertension, and it uses this data to advise employers on awareness programmes.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From Insurance to Wellness: Inside Jubilee Life Insurance Approach | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-10-08)

fact_text: Jubilee said its panel deals with leading hospitals include free outpatient consultations, test discounts and medicine discounts, usable before illness as well as during treatment.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From Insurance to Wellness: Inside Jubilee Life Insurance Approach | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-10-08)

fact_text: Jubilee's app is free and open to non-customers, and links to Apple, Samsung and Fitbit fitness apps so users earn rewards for healthy activity, redeemable at discount partners.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From Insurance to Wellness: Inside Jubilee Life Insurance Approach | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-10-08)

fact_text: Jubilee's app rewards come in Silver, Platinum and Gold card tiers, with Silver offering fewer benefits and the level rising as a member's points grow.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From Insurance to Wellness: Inside Jubilee Life Insurance Approach | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-10-08)

fact_text: Jubilee's app offers free online doctor consultations for members and their families, available round the clock, including late at night.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From Insurance to Wellness: Inside Jubilee Life Insurance Approach | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-10-08)

fact_text: Management said its wellness plan is a continuous programme rather than a one-time event, and that its effects on employee health appear after two to three years, not in the first year.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From Insurance to Wellness: Inside Jubilee Life Insurance Approach | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-10-08)

fact_text: Jubilee said panel-card verification with CNIC at hospitals helps reduce fraudulent claims, because the insurer can match each visit against its own panel records.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From Insurance to Wellness: Inside Jubilee Life Insurance Approach | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-10-08)

fact_text: Jubilee offers education and marriage plans and a lump-sum benefit if the breadwinner dies, and management said families should plan savings for children's schooling and marriage around age 18.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From Insurance to Wellness: Inside Jubilee Life Insurance Approach | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-10-08)

fact_text: Insurers price group health cover on actual claim incidence rates rather than on the premium paid, so benefit design can be changed at each renewal, according to the interviewee.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From Insurance to Wellness: Inside Jubilee Life Insurance Approach | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-10-08)

fact_text: Management said employers often treat group health cover as a cost item, and when benefits are fixed and generic, employees feel dissatisfied while the employer feels its spend is wasted.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From Insurance to Wellness: Inside Jubilee Life Insurance Approach | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-10-08)

fact_text: For out-of-pocket hospital claims, insurers need a discharge certificate or the doctor's treatment plan, and the interviewee said many employees submit only a slip, which delays reimbursement.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From Insurance to Wellness: Inside Jubilee Life Insurance Approach | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-10-08)

fact_text: Panel hospitals usually admit insured members without a cash deposit, whereas non-panel hospitals often ask for cash before treatment, which management called a common problem in Pakistan.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From Insurance to Wellness: Inside Jubilee Life Insurance Approach | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-10-08)

fact_text: A room-rent entitlement of 5,000 rupees can leave an employee paying the gap when a private room costs 8,000 rupees; the interviewee gave an example of 3,000 rupees paid out of pocket.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From Insurance to Wellness: Inside Jubilee Life Insurance Approach | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-10-08)

fact_text: The interviewee advised employers to benchmark room entitlements on a hospital such as Liaquat National rather than Aga Khan's general ward, so the benefit covers rooms at more hospitals.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From Insurance to Wellness: Inside Jubilee Life Insurance Approach | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-10-08)

fact_text: Management defined workplace wellness in layers: financial wellbeing first, meaning salary and promised benefits paid on time, then mental wellbeing, then physical health through prevention.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From Insurance to Wellness: Inside Jubilee Life Insurance Approach | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-10-08)

fact_text: Management said employee wellbeing has moved from HR into business strategy, and that companies ignoring staff health will struggle to build sustainable models.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From Insurance to Wellness: Inside Jubilee Life Insurance Approach | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-10-08)

fact_text: Management said unlimited medical cover at some government institutions did not solve their staff problems, so insurance or group cover alone is not enough.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From Insurance to Wellness: Inside Jubilee Life Insurance Approach | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-10-08)

fact_text: Management said mental wellbeing is a worldwide challenge, to be distinguished from psychiatric illness, and that long commutes, screen time and poor workspaces add stress to staff.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From Insurance to Wellness: Inside Jubilee Life Insurance Approach | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-10-08)

fact_text: The interviewee said hybrid and remote work saves employees commuting, clothing and meal costs, which affects their financial and mental wellbeing.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From Insurance to Wellness: Inside Jubilee Life Insurance Approach | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-10-08)

fact_text: The interviewee said multinationals such as Unilever Pakistan once attracted staff through retirement, during-job and maternity benefits, so pay alone was not the draw.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From Insurance to Wellness: Inside Jubilee Life Insurance Approach | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-10-08)

fact_text: The interviewee said economic pressure, inflation and city traffic in Pakistan add stress that affects employees' mental wellbeing and sleep.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From Insurance to Wellness: Inside Jubilee Life Insurance Approach | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-10-08)
